provenance.classes.*.length_m, footprint_m: The design starting values (Classic 60-80 m within 20 x 20 m, Featured 90-110 m within 30 x 20 m); the same numbers are CLASS_LIMITS of sketch/examples/check.py
provenance.classes.*.centre_extent_m: class footprint minus 1.5 m on every side: the largest outer half width 1.1 m + one duct 0.33 m + 0.07 m; the outer walls then always fit in the class box
provenance.classes.classic.min_width_m: The design: the 1.0 m narrow section is a Featured feature; Classic stays above the feature threshold NARROW_SECTION_M 1.2 with 0.05 m margin
provenance.classes.*.open_walls, spine_notches, nar: The design (Classic: gaps + 1 open wall + patches; Featured: + carpet tile, black outer ducts, 1.0 m narrow section, shared wall, 2 open walls)
provenance.shape.spine_radius_m: a hairpin around the free end of a shared row: centreline radius = inner half width + duct radius; 0.92 keeps the discrete minimum radius above check.py's 0.9 - 0.02
provenance.shape.min_radius_m, radius_*: estimate: a bend with its own inner wall needs radius >= duct bend 0.5 + duct radius 0.165 + half width 0.32 + smoothing margin 0.08 + 0.05 = 1.12 m; only the spine hairpin (inner side = the free end of the shared row) goes down to 0.92 m (the design minimum 0.9 m); real hall tracks mix hairpins of about 1 m with sweepers of several metres
provenance.shape.notch_*, step_m, chamfer_m: estimate: notches are the bights of real layouts (IROS 2026 tube layout, ICRA 2026 Classic map)
provenance.width.wide_m, wide_prob, frac_ge_1p5_min: The design: 1.0-2.2 m, at least 70 % of the length at 1.5 m or more (margin 0.02)
provenance.width.duct_bend_min_m: estimate: smallest axis radius a 0.33 m flexible duct is laid at (inner surface radius 0.335 m); with 0.508 m pieces the chord sagitta stays 0.069 m, inside check.py's 0.10 m
provenance.width.wall_clearance_m: estimate: free floor between two separate rows of ducts; two sections are then at least 0.71 m apart face to face, so no pair falls under the 0.5 m sharing rule (IROS 2026 tube_layout.py GAP)
provenance.width.far_station_m: estimate: two samples count as different parts of the lap beyond 3 m of station (a 0.92 m hairpin is 2.9 m long)
provenance.width.slope: estimate: half width changes by at most 0.25 m per metre of station
provenance.width.smooth_*: the lower envelope is smoothed (two passes of a +-0.6 m moving average) against the caps lowered by 0.08 m, so that the duct axis has no kinks; duct_bend_check_m rejects an attempt whose duct axis still bends tighter than 0.42 m
provenance.width.bend_pad_m: estimate: a bend's inner cap holds 1.2 m before and after it, so that the half width has reached its value before the bend (a ramp inside the bend kinks the inner duct axis; measured on development seeds)
provenance.walls.last_duct_min_m: estimate: when a full duct would leave less than 2 m to the end of a run, the rest is laid as two ducts of about half each (no short stub)
provenance.walls.butt_prob, gap_m: The design end gaps 0-15 cm; half of the junctions butted is an estimate from the 2026 photos
provenance.walls.piece_final_m: a compressed duct's piece length (the contract allows 0.35-0.65); capped at 0.53 m so that the sagitta stays inside check.py's 0.10 m on the tightest duct bend
provenance.walls.palette_probs, mixed_switch_prob: estimate: ICRA 2026 all orange, IROS 2026 yellow and orange mixed
provenance.walls.black_frac: The design: Featured outer wall 0-30 % plain black; at least one duct so that the feature is present
provenance.open_walls.width_m: The design and the contract: 0.6-1.2 m, narrower than the track
provenance.open_walls.behind_clear_m: no other section of the track within 3 m behind an opening: the cell tests a tape whenever the car's reference point is within (half width + 0.6 m) x 2 (L1) of its midpoint, and a wheel of a car on a section behind the opening would count as beyond the tape (found by the reference program on candidate s3f_mid_1ed2eefa72c3, 63 stops)
provenance.floor.tiers, kinds: The design / check.py GRIP_TIERS and TIER_FLOOR_KINDS
provenance.floor.dust_factor, metal_factor, carpet_: estimate; direction from the league's venue notes of the givens (dust and covers grip less, a carpet tile grips differently); no measurement. Final: dust = base x U(0.72, 0.85), metal cover = base x U(0.68, 0.82), carpet tile on a hard floor max(U(0.80, 0.92), base + 0.08), on carpet base - U(0.10, 0.18), the first patch at the apex of a bend (turn >= 1 rad, radius <= 3.5 m) covering most of the corridor; frozen with the generator at selection, not tuned before the Opus episode (levers T1, T2)
provenance.floor.carpet_edge_m: The design / ICRA 2026: carpet edge up to 7 mm
provenance.floor.side_pull_factor, side_pull_mass_k: estimate: the organiser's reading with its own reference car at one spot, a peak (ICRA 2026: <= 20 N with a 3.8 kg car); implied friction = base grip x U(0.90, 1.15). Final: test mass 3.0-4.5 kg in 0.1 kg steps, force rounded to 0.5 N; venues.md states that this car's grip has been about 0.85 to 1.15 times the implied friction (true range 1 / 1.15 .. 1 / 0.90 = 0.87 .. 1.11)
provenance.clutter.*: The design and the contract: pillars, table legs, crates, banners at least 0.5 m from the walls; sizes are estimates
